note: Contests that can appear on ballots in the Town of Gilbert, grouped by the jurisdiction that votes on them. Gilbert is divided among several congressional, legislative, school and special districts, so the exact ballot depends on the street address. A ZIP code alone does not determine a ballot. Other districts that include parts of Gilbert may not be covered here. Check the official sample ballot for any address at BeBallotReady.Vote.
